correctness.rationale: Two genuinely different exhaustive state encodings were executed from the exact packaged code. The exact-cover enumeration of 105 matchings builds 6240 complete partitions; 4+4-cycle detection builds 17640 undirected switches and all 961 connected components; BFS from each of the 5280 mobile vertices yields degrees 3,7,9,13,21 with eccentricities 11,10,10,10,9. The separate normalized edge-coloring enumerator recovers the same states and transitions and proves each of the six degree strata a full S8 orbit, allowing separate representative BFS. The commuting-involution lemma and AGL(3,2) orbit count independently identify all 30 centers. No unproved infinite generalization is claimed.

value.rationale: For fixed labelled players, known connectivity of a six-isomorphism-type quotient does not resolve whether actual schedules can be reached by local trades; this is a natural operational and mathematical distinction. The new result gives full labelled reachability except for known perfect obstructions, sharp trade diameter eleven, radius nine, and complete classification of the thirty optimal centers as affine translation structures. The abelian-regular-group argument supplies a motivated structural interpretation rather than merely reproducing known count tables.
